# Every seat reviews an amendment before a decision is recorded (replaces D187 targeted re-ask)
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #319, sha256:bef74bfbf50252c61a2430031da6a8a56ec14f249fd89526f2f47728533e33e2). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (process change filed by the product owner as a story)

**Story**
As the product owner, I want every recorded team decision to have been approved by every voting seat on its final text, so that I can trust that a decision the team reports really reflects the whole team's review, including amendments added after round 1.

**Context**
Rule D187 (one condition, targeted re-ask) re-asks only the seat that raised the condition and any seat whose quoted point the amended text changes. A condition adds new text that no other seat has quoted. If that text introduces a risk another role would catch (QA, architect, security), that seat never sees it, and the decision passes on round-1 votes cast against different text. Raised by the product owner on 2026-11-07 while reviewing the card 313 task-force window.

**Proposed change** (the team refines it)
After any amendment, every voting seat of that window receives only the change (a diff, plus a one-line why) in a fresh context, and replies NO OBJECTION or OBJECTION with one fixed condition. A full re-poll stays for any real No, and for multiple or conflicting conditions. This replaces the targeted re-ask of D187 and ends that trial.

**Acceptance criteria**

```gherkin
Feature: Every seat approves an amendment before a decision is recorded

  Scenario: [S][O] One condition is folded in and every seat reviews the change
    Given a window whose round 1 has five NO OBJECTION and one objection with one condition
    When the facilitator folds the condition into the proposal
    Then all six seats receive the amendment as a diff in fresh contexts
    And the window record lists each seat's reply to the diff
    And the decision is recorded only after every seat has replied NO OBJECTION to the final text

  Scenario: [E] A seat objects to the amendment that another seat asked for
    Given an amendment adopted from one seat's condition
    When another seat replies OBJECTION to the diff with a condition
    Then the decision is not recorded
    And the window follows the protocol for an unresolved objection

  Scenario: [Z] No amendment was needed
    Given a window whose round 1 has six NO OBJECTION
    When the facilitator records the decision
    Then no diff review is sent
    And the record states that no amendment was made

  Scenario: [M] Several amendments in sequence
    Given a window amended twice
    When each amendment is folded in
    Then every seat reviews each diff before the next amendment
    And the record shows one reply per seat per diff

  Scenario: [B] A seat does not reply to the diff in time
    Given a diff review in which one seat has not replied within the window's timeout
    When the timeout passes
    Then that seat is re-run once on another available driver
    And the decision is not recorded until that seat has replied

  Scenario: [I] The record is checkable by the product owner and the auditor
    Given a recorded decision that had an amendment
    When the product owner or the external auditor reads the window record on main
    Then they can see the final text, every diff, and each seat's verbatim reply to each diff
    And the process check fails any record where a seat's diff reply is missing
```

ZOMBIES: Z, O, M, B, I, E and S are each covered above.
